mascot.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create an original charming editorial mascot logo for DIRWELL, a small tool that publishes directories of files as static websites. The concept is a paper scout: a curious little bird made from a folded index page, with a distinctive compact silhouette, oversized observant dark eye, a small confident beak, a single warm vermilion folded wing, and a cream page-body whose folded corner subtly suggests paper. It feels clever, welcoming and a little mischievous, never corporate or babyish. Aim for the quality of an independent publisher or Japanese stationery brand's character emblem: expressive flat cut-paper forms, purposeful asymmetry, warm curves with crisp fold edges. Give the character personality through its pose and eye, not through busy accessories. Palette: warm cream #f3f0e8, ink #171815, vermilion #dc5235. Thick enough outline only where needed to separate the cream body on light paper. No literal D, no stock folder, no glasses, no hats, no tools, no extra objects. Single mascot centered in a square with clear margins; occupies about 70% of canvas. Flat graphic illustration, no shadows, lighting, gradient, grain, 3D or photo realism. No text, no wordmark, no caption or surrounding frame. This is a brand character, its large shape and eye must remain clear as a small icon. Background: true alpha transparency everywhere outside the character and in the gaps. No white matte, no painted checkerboard, no grid.

og.prompt: Generate a COMPLETE finished Open Graph share image for Dirwell in a wide landscape canvas, ideal ratio 1200:630 (40:21). Use the supplied image as the approved, fixed mascot identity: preserve this exact cream folded-page bird, its big expressive black eye, orange-red folded wing and beak, black outline and feet, and curious upward pose. Do not turn it into another bird. This is the entire final artwork including typography and composition, not an isolated asset. Direction 1: an independent publisher's cover. Warm paper #f3f0e8 background, elegant expressive dark editorial serif lettering with carefully considered typography and ample breathing room. The bird is large and lively on the right, the left carries only these exact texts: 'Dirwell' as the primary name, 'Put a directory on the web.' as the main statement, 'A searchable static file explorer.' as a small supporting line. Typography must be beautifully spaced, crisp and readable at social thumbnail size. No slogans beyond those exact lines, no badges, fake metrics, feature pills, browser frames, charts, decoration grids, URLs, watermarks, labels or extra characters. Finish the entire image in one image-tool output. Avoid gradients, glossy rendering, generic SaaS marketing templates or checkerboards. Keep the original hand-crafted paper mascot's charm, not a stiff generic folder icon. Clean generous margins on all sides; do not crop the bird or text. Create a polished, distinctive complete brand image.
og.postprocessing: Proportional downscaling only; lossless PNG encoding. No cropping, compositing, relettering, or layout edits.

Warm paper background #f3f0e8, ink-black typography, restrained orange from its wing. Use outstanding custom-feeling editorial type and an asymmetrical composition with generous clear margins. Preserve mascot personality and proportions; no extra birds. All illustration, lettering and layout must be finished by the image tool in this ONE output, suitable to use directly as a share image.
